facts.text: Georgia Southwestern carries forward the legacy of alumnus Jimmy Carter through the President Jimmy Carter Leadership Program.

sources.title: President Jimmy Carter Leadership Program | Georgia Southwestern State University
sources.quote: Georgia Southwestern State University is honored to carry forward the legacy of GSW alumnus and former U.S. President Jimmy Carter with the President Jimmy Carter Leadership Program.

facts.text: Students in the Carter Leadership Program receive a $2,000 scholarship each year for up to four years.

sources.title: President Jimmy Carter Leadership Program | Georgia Southwestern State University
sources.quote: Students in the Carter Leadership Program will receive a scholarship of $2,000 each year they are in the program for up to four years.
